purpose: Declare runtime components intentionally excluded from O76 proof authority, with reasons and replacement paths.
principle: Removal means removal from the authoritative proof runtime, not deletion from the historical source corpus.

items.component: Riemann/RH numerical probe and finite-grid analytics
items.reason: Finite numerical evidence, zeta evaluations, Li probes and contour/grid experiments cannot establish the universal proposition of the Riemann hypothesis. Keeping them in the proof authority would repeat E43-E58.
items.replacement: Keep such material only as external experiment/audit; O76 proof runtime uses exact symbolic certificates only.

items.reason: The nine checkpoint artifacts are historical model components, not deterministic proof certificates, and are not required for the exact math kernel.
items.replacement: Pure-stdlib exact symbolic runtime; a future neural proposer may be added only as non-authoritative candidate generation.

items.component: Benchmark result snapshots and injected final answers
items.reason: Using benchmark outputs as resolution logic would violate R03/R14 and can create false proofs through answer leakage.
items.replacement: Examples remain input-only; the runtime recomputes results from the stated problem.

items.component: Legacy LLM and non-math domain wrappers
items.reason: The requested O76 model is dedicated to mathematics. Retaining unrelated domain classifiers would reintroduce semantic ambiguity documented by E02-E17.
items.replacement: Explicit MathProblem contract and deterministic parser.

items.reason: Stringifying Python objects loses mathematical structure and prevents replay; this directly addresses E28.
items.replacement: Structured poly_payload, exact generator representations, canonical JSON and problem hash.

items.component: Rule treating a complete Groebner basis as a solved theorem
source_patterns: structural Groebner result used as proof
items.reason: A complete basis is an algebraic invariant, not by itself a certificate that a requested target equals zero; this directly addresses E27.
items.replacement: Representation-tracking Buchberger plus explicit ideal-identity certificate replay.

items.reason: They contain no JSON data and correspond to harness interruption history E38; an empty stdout/file cannot be used as a mathematical result.
items.replacement: Internal checkpoint/log files and explicit UNRESOLVED status.

items.reason: The source history explicitly removed external solver authority. O76 keeps the proof kernel auditable and deterministic with Python standard library only.

items.component: Raw prose claims of universal mathematical truth outside the formal input grammar
source_patterns: Riemann hypothesis statements without formal relation encoding
items.reason: The decisive test showed that accepting natural-language universal claims without a formal semantics would create an unsound bridge from prose to proof. Such inputs are classified UNSUPPORTED_FORM/UNRESOLVED.
items.replacement: Require an exact supported contract or a future formally specified theorem language with an independent verifier.
